Click To Visit Debbie's New Interactive Online Destination, Awakening Body & Lifedebbierosas.comCLASSESFind a Nia class near you or online and begin your journey of body and life transformation.SearchNIA ON DEMANDExperience the magic of Nia through at-home dance workouts, podcasts, meditations and exclusive livestreams all at your fingertips.2 Weeks Free!WELCOME TO NIANia is more than just a workout. It is a holistic fitness practice addressing each aspect of your life - body, mind and soul. Combining dance, martial arts and mindfulness, Nia conditions and strengthens your body while transforming your mind...At Nia, we believe every person can discover, explore, unleash, and enhance their individual potential to live a healthy and meaningful life by engaging their senses and listening to their bodies.Nia is based on the intelligent design of the body. Each workout combines mindfulness and dynamic movement - leaving you energized, mentally clear, and emotionally balanced.Nia workouts combine 52 simple moves with dance arts, martial arts, and healing arts to energize and enliven well-being in 60 minutes - body, mind, emotion, and spirit.Nia is non-impact, practiced barefoot, and adaptable to individual needs and abilities. Nia classes are taught by licensed Nia teachers and trainers in dozens of countries and languages across the world.FIND YOUR GLOBAL FEEL GOOD FITNESSYou can find Nia classes and trainings all over the world. Dance with us in Paris. Sweat with us in Sydney. Heal with us in Helsinki.
